channel.title: Wander Notes
channel.description: Travel stories, itineraries and practical tips from the road by Adarsh Nair: where to go, how to get around and what it really costs.

item.title: Morocco for the 2027 Eclipse: The Budget Alternative to Spain
item.description: On 2 August 2027 the Moon's shadow crosses the Strait of Gibraltar. Southern Spain's eclipse hotels already cost thousands, but across the water in northern Morocco totality lasts longer and rooms still cost under $150. Here's a seven-day plan through Tangier and Chefchaouen, with timings, weather odds and checked hotels.
item.author: adarshnair01@gmail.com (Adarsh Nair)

item.title: Seychelles in ten days: Mahé, Praslin and La Digue by ferry and bike
item.description: Ten days in the Seychelles from the US: Mahé's mountains and reefs, Praslin's coco de mer forest, and La Digue by bike, with ferry fares, real prices in dollars, checked hotels and the boat trips worth booking.
item.author: adarshnair01@gmail.com (Adarsh Nair)

item.title: Thailand in ten days over Christmas: Chiang Mai, Bangkok and Krabi
item.description: Ten days in Thailand over Christmas week: cool mornings and night markets in Chiang Mai, the Grand Palace and Chinatown in Bangkok, and Christmas Day on Railay's beaches in Krabi, with the new 30-day entry rule, real costs, checked hotels and what sells out first.
item.author: adarshnair01@gmail.com (Adarsh Nair)

item.title: Kashmir in five nights from Delhi: Srinagar, Gulmarg and Pahalgam
item.description: Five nights in Kashmir from Delhi: a houseboat and shikara mornings on Dal Lake, Srinagar's Mughal gardens and old city, the Gulmarg gondola, and Pahalgam's Betaab and Aru valleys, with flight and train options, real costs, checked stays and what's open right now.
item.author: adarshnair01@gmail.com (Adarsh Nair)

item.title: Finnish Lapland in ten days: Helsinki, Rovaniemi and Saariselkä in January
item.description: Ten winter days in Finland from the US: a night in Helsinki, the Santa Claus Express to Rovaniemi, then north to Saariselkä and Inari for huskies, reindeer, snowshoes and the northern lights, with real prices in dollars, checked hotels and the tours worth booking.
item.author: adarshnair01@gmail.com (Adarsh Nair)

item.title: Japan in twelve days: Tokyo, Hakone, Kyoto, Hiroshima and Osaka
item.description: A twelve-day first trip to Japan by bullet train: four nights in Tokyo, an onsen night in Hakone, three in Kyoto, one in Hiroshima and two in Osaka, with real fares, checked hotels, the Klook tickets and codes worth using, and why you can skip the JR Pass.
item.author: adarshnair01@gmail.com (Adarsh Nair)

item.title: Taipei, Taitung and Kaohsiung: five days down Taiwan's east coast
item.description: Five days and four nights in Taiwan: two nights in Taipei, the train down the east coast to Taitung, then the South-Link line to Kaohsiung, with real fares, checked hotels, Klook tickets worth booking and the closures to plan around.
item.author: adarshnair01@gmail.com (Adarsh Nair)

item.title: Bengaluru to Wayanad: four days of forests, caves and coffee
item.description: A four-day road trip from Bengaluru through Bandipur to Wayanad: Edakkal's carved cave, a jeep safari in Muthanga, Banasura's reservoir, Thirunelli and Kuruva, with real bus fares, safari timings and the night-ban rules you need to plan around.
item.author: adarshnair01@gmail.com (Adarsh Nair)

item.title: Bengaluru to the sea: six days down the Karnataka coast
item.description: A six-day route from Bengaluru through the Western Ghats to Mangaluru, Udupi, Murudeshwar and Gokarna, with real fares, ferry timings and what to eat at every stop.
item.author: adarshnair01@gmail.com (Adarsh Nair)

item.title: Hampi: Three Days Among Ancient Ruins and Boulders
item.description: Explore Hampi, the ancient Vijayanagara capital, with our 3-day guide. From scooter rides across the river to iconic sunsets and coracle adventures.
item.author: adarshnair01@gmail.com (Adarsh Nair)
